name: frontend-design-skills-benchmark
title_zh: 80 次实测告诉你：生成式技能比买来的便宜且不差
tagline_zh: 16 组配置、80 次跑分、精确到分的成本账。别再拍脑袋选技能——用数据决定是买现成的还是现场生成的。
tagline_en: 16 configs, 80 runs, exact cost accounting. Stop guessing—let data decide between buying skills or generating.
desc_en: A/B test of front-end design agent skills: 16 configurations, 80 runs, exact cost accounting. Generated skills beat purchased ones on cost and match them on output.
why_zh: 不是晒个例，是完整实验矩阵。同一任务、同一基准，生成式在成本上碾压、产出持平，结论可复现。
why_en: Not cherry-picked demos—a full experiment matrix. Same task, same benchmark: generated wins on cost, ties on quality, fully.
limit_zh: 只覆盖前端设计类 Agent 技能，不含后端、文案、数据分析等其他域。基准任务固定为 80 次跑分。
limit_en: Front-end design agent skills only; no backend, copywriting, or data analysis. Fixed 80-run benchmark—other task sets may shift results. Requires an.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: 80-run A/B test: generated skills cost less, match output
